sloka: न हि शक्ष्यामि अहम् द्रष्टुम् सुग्रीवम् मैथिलीम् विना ।मयि अगच्चति च इहस्थे धर्म आत्मानौ महा रथौ ॥५-१३-३९॥
transliteration: na hi śakṣyāmi aham draṣṭum sugrīvam maithilīm vinā ।mayi agaccati ca ihasthe dharma ātmānau mahā rathau ॥5-13-39॥

translations.english: Both the highsouled warrior princes treading a righteous path as well as the vanaras will survive with a hope of my return if I stay back.
